headline: Last session: Nifty reclaims 23,000 as Sensex gains 308 points led by IT and Pharma stocks

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Monday, 2 November.

why: Rally in IT and Pharma stocks provided significant support to the indices
Nifty successfully reclaimed the 23,000 psychological level during the last session
Strong buying interest in large-cap stocks like IndiGo and HCLTech
Underperformance in midcap and smallcap segments limited the overall market upside
whatHappening: Tata Motors integrated Iveco into the group and appointed N Chandrasekaran as Chairperson
ISRO's GSLV rocket successfully placed the NVS-03 satellite into its designated orbit
Apple overtook Nvidia to regain its position as the world's most valuable company
Global markets reacted to the Nasdaq's worst monthly performance since 2025 due to an AI rout
summary: In the last trading session, the Nifty reclaimed the 23,000 mark as the Sensex rose 308 points, driven by gains in IT and Pharma sectors. Corporate news was highlighted by Tata Motors integrating Iveco into its group, while IndiGo and HCLTech shares saw notable gains. However, the broader market remained weak with midcaps and smallcaps underperforming.
